body_markdown: AE-19 isolates the safe factor-linearization statement with $\Delta\le D<p$, not $\Delta<D$. The common lift must satisfy $C_Z\ne0$: researcher-0006 P7--P9 gives a minimum-weight singular counterexample without this hypothesis. At a simple lift, formal implicit uniqueness and more than $\Delta$ directions yield $C=u(Z-Q)$.
subject: Simple-lift factor linearization
